entries.symptom: A screenshot caught mid-animation, or the capture fails [unstable]: the screen never held still for 300 ms
entries.cause: The capture ran before the screen settled, or a loop (withRepeat, a timer, a blinking caret, a polling spinner) keeps running because it ignores reduce motion
entries.fix: Capture until two screenshots in a row are identical; route every loop through useReduceMotion() so the parity launch rests it (never a capture-only branch); never waive it or raise the settle time for a loop

entries.symptom: The capture stops with "hierarchy from another device", or maestro hierarchy shows another screen or language than the one launched
entries.cause: Maestro reached another session's simulator or emulator: a call named no --device, or two sessions' drivers shared one port
entries.fix: Name the device on every call (maestro --device <id> with its own --driver-host-port, simctl by UDID, adb -s <serial>) and use your own <project>-parity device; the capture proves each dump by its launch nonce

entries.symptom: "hierarchy from another device" although your own device and port were used, and the rejected hierarchy lists only the home screen (SpringBoard, the launcher); or the device log says "RPC timeout. Apparently deadlocked"
entries.cause: The app was not running: it crashed or aborted after launch (on a saturated machine, for example an audio engine abort when coreaudiod times out), so the launch nonce never reached the dump
entries.fix: Read the rejected hierarchy first: home-screen ids mean the app died. Find the crash (iOS crash reports in DiagnosticReports, Android adb -s <serial> logcat -d -s AndroidRuntime:E ReactNativeJS:V), fix it or capture on an idle machine, then capture again with the same build

entries.symptom: Every capture of a dialog frame fails screen-not-reached: the root testID (the scrim) is not on screen, although the dialog is visible
entries.cause: accessibilityViewIsModal sits on an inner view (the dialog card), so iOS drops its siblings and the modal root's testID from the accessibility tree that Maestro reads
entries.fix: Put accessibilityViewIsModal on the modal root (the Scrim; VoiceOver still stays inside the dialog) and render the launch marker as its first child (ui-component-library owns the Scrim)
match: the root testID \S*scrim\S* is not on screen

entries.symptom: A tall screen captured at a deep scroll offset stops short: scroll-mismatch
entries.cause: The ScrollView laid out before the safe-area insets arrived, so iOS clamped the offset to a smaller maximum; a scroll made only in onContentSizeChange never runs again
entries.fix: Scroll from both onContentSizeChange and onLayout, without animation (the screen body's scrollToY fed by useFrameScrollTarget())

entries.symptom: The status bar shows a back breadcrumb ("◀ <other app>") in a screenshot
entries.cause: The app was opened from another app (a deep link, Settings, Safari), so iOS draws a way back to it
entries.fix: Terminate the other app and launch this one cleanly by bundle id on your own simulator (simctl launch <udid>); never open parity frames through a deep link on iOS

entries.symptom: maestro hierarchy reports the real time and battery although the status bar is overridden
entries.cause: xcrun simctl status_bar override changes only the pixels, not the accessibility tree
entries.fix: Leave the status bar band (the top safe area) out of element checks; compare it on pixels only

entries.symptom: The design shows a home indicator that the simulator screenshot lacks
entries.cause: simctl io screenshot includes the Dynamic Island but never the home indicator
entries.fix: Hide the home indicator in the design render; do not mask the bottom of both images

entries.symptom: A design reference renders a few pixels taller or wider than the device screen (1206x2625 for a 1206x2622 screen)
entries.cause: An element screenshot of an in-flow frame sat on a fractional CSS offset
entries.fix: Pin the frame at (0,0) with position: fixed and clip a page screenshot to the device size

entries.symptom: Every element is the same few points lower (or higher) than in the design
entries.cause: The design frame uses another device geometry (point size, status bar, safe-area top) than the capture device
entries.fix: Render the design at the capture device's geometry (its point size and safe top) and mask the top safe area

entries.symptom: A 1 pt shift, a lighter font weight or a wrong string passes a whole-screen pixel-percentage gate; a colour change is invisible in the heatmap
entries.cause: Whole-screen pixel-difference and SSIM noise floors overlap real defects, and a loose colour threshold misses a changed hex
entries.fix: Gate per element by testID: geometry within 2 pt, exact text, fill within 3 per channel, text ink metrics, aligned crop structure; report global numbers for information only

entries.symptom: Text sits 1 to 2 pt lower or higher than in the design while its glyphs match
entries.cause: React Native places text inside its line height differently from CSS half-leading
entries.fix: Keep the 2 pt position tolerance for text and compare ink width and height; never move text with a transform or padding to match

entries.symptom: check-parity fails [structure] with 1 to 2 pt blobs along a dashed border that no style change removes
entries.cause: React Native on iOS draws borderStyle dashed with its own dash length and phase, which no style sets, so the dashes never line up with the browser render
entries.fix: Record a platform waiver for that element (rule structure, this cause) in a Gate-Change commit and name it in the report; never redraw the edge or widen the tolerance. A structure failure on a solid edge is a real difference

entries.symptom: A screen passes parity only after a tolerance was raised or a reference was rendered again
entries.cause: Widening a tolerance or regenerating a reference to clear a failure hides the defect
entries.fix: Restore the tolerance and the reference and fix the app; a real platform difference becomes a reviewed waiver

entries.symptom: Automated parity passed, but a person still found wrong icons, shadows, alignment or mirroring
entries.cause: Machines cannot judge icons, shadows, optical alignment or RTL mirroring, and the side-by-side sheets were never looked at
entries.fix: Look at every side-by-side sheet and record the sign-off tied to the sheet's hash

entries.symptom: A sign-off or report drafted shortly after midnight carries yesterday's date
entries.cause: The date came from the UTC calendar day (toISOString().slice(0, 10)) instead of the local day
entries.fix: Write the local calendar day (or pass the day explicitly); correct a drafted date before committing the ledger (dates-streaks-and-statistics owns the local-day rule)
